summary: CONFIRMED: at this call site, growth never produces an edge while learningMode != "off" (frozen argument forces it closed), and even with learningMode=="off" it only fires when rewardGate is explicitly false (reward is hardcoded 0, and rewardGate&&reward<=0 blocks the call otherwise).

CONFIRMED: growthState.windows stayed 0 after 60 real sample() calls under the most growth-favorable configuration. FdbGrowth.observe() is never invoked from DualAgentContext.sample(); the field exists only because it is constructed and (de)serialized. Growth is dead code on this path, not merely gated -- it cannot fire regardless of configuration. Any acquiredEdgesAfter>0 is attributable to FdbLearning alone, not FdbGrowth.

CONFIRMED: FdbLearning reads, reweights and (given enough sustained negative evidence) removes an edge regardless of whether FdbGrowth or FdbLearning itself created it -- GraphDelta.Edge carries no origin tag, and FdbLearning.feedback's trace loop iterates layer.edges() unconditionally. This is expected given the current public contract (no provenance field exists), not a bug in either class; it is the concrete mechanism behind the open question in docs/FDB_RESEARCH_ITERATION_2026-10-16_RU.md about whether an explicit provenance field is warranted.
